lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, transitioning from dense clusters in the mid-flank to larger, more isolated points towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral blobs, forming a discernible grid pattern along the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by elevated luminance on the dorsal edge transitioning to shadowed regions immediately ventral.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance spots distributed irregularly across its lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: High density of small, point-source luminance maxima concentrated on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit, contrasting with the larger lateral spot patterning.
